---
name: Integration request
about: Ask for support for another coding agent or tool
labels: integration
---

**Agent / tool name and version**

**Documented hook or notification mechanism** (link to official docs)

**Events it exposes** (finished, needs permission, needs input, failed, ...)

**Can it run a local command or write JSON somewhere?**

Note: AgentPing only integrates through documented mechanisms. It does not scrape
terminal output.
